column6: The offset only feeds (j + w) % 3, and adding 3 before that modulo leaves the result the same for every twist value, so the occupancy bytes are identical on clean and mutant code.

twists[7] only reaches build_occ, which reduces it modulo 3 before use, and the mutant values 6, 5, 4 carry the same residues as the clean values 0, 2, 1, so every generated scramble is byte for byte unchanged.

spins and budget only feed panic guards that already have should_panic tests, and once a guard goes quiet the walk loops forever instead of returning or failing, so the mutant can only show up as a hang and no terminating test can catch it.

the slot diagonal carries a nonzero component on every axis and the cross product of two slot face normals picks a single axis, so the dot product is always exactly 1 or minus 1, checked over all 48 slot face pairs, and the equals branch of >= is unreachable for every cube state.
SIGN holds only 1 and minus 1 for the six faces, so admitting zero changes no face and every layer permutation stays byte for byte the same.
the mutant raises the applied quarter turn count by exactly 4 and rot composes four quarter turns into the identity, so both counts land every sticker on the same cell for every quarter value.

the guard is redundant with the parser, parse_unit rejects the empty string at its is_empty check and parse_core rejects Not found. for lacking a bracket, so both guarded inputs still return None through the parse path and no input changes verdict.

the mutant prefills home stickers on unwritten slots, but place_rigid overwrites every slot of the three cycled pieces before any lookup because all error paths precede its write loop, and non cycled stickers resolve to home under both variants, so every verdict is identical.

the ch masks (e and f) and (not e and g) are bitwise disjoint so or equals xor, and the maj chain is 1 per bit exactly when at least two of the three pair products are set, where xor equals or, so all three swaps leave every digest identical.
